VERBATIM.label: verbatim
VERBATIM.description: Text unchanged between prior and current document versions.

NEAR_VERBATIM.label: near verbatim
NEAR_VERBATIM.description: Minor edits preserving the same substantive meaning.

REVISED.label: revised
REVISED.description: Substantive rewrite of an existing segment.

NEW.label: new
NEW.description: Segment present only in the current document.

DROPPED.label: dropped
DROPPED.description: Segment explicitly removed with a positive removal signal.

UNKNOWN_ABSENCE.label: unknown absence
UNKNOWN_ABSENCE.description: Prior mention missing without an explicit removal signal.
